claim: A treatment is accepted only within its quality and cost contract.

task.path_reachability: The task must read SKILL.md and execute the step removed by T1.

witness.delivery: Guard the mutated copy before dispatch and retain the delivery log outside the host tree.
witness.checker: skill-guard fixture suite plus task-specific delivery witness
blind_spots: A clean-tail semantic truncation may pass skill-guard.

invalid_rules: host permission failure before reading the fixture

isolation.mode: temporary copies, fake HOME, sandboxed host

ethics.blast_radius: Temporary local fixtures only; no production or third-party writes.

cost_policy.retry_policy: zero silent retries; every authorized attempt receipted
cost_policy.billing_alignment: identical model, prompt prefix, retry and cache conditions apart from treatment
cost_policy.decision_rule: reject when quality is tied and cost per success exceeds control by more than 0.02 USD
